setting: Local release-worktree Chromium classroom with live Jev and MiniMax

cohort.learner: My guess is round, because three of the four tiles are round.
cohort.opportunity: Confirm that round is more likely because three of four tiles are round. Do not replace the open Question or grade an unsubmitted form.

cohort.learner: What is the chemical symbol for copper? Just the symbol, please.
cohort.opportunity: Give the symbol Cu. The learner expressly wants only the symbol.

cohort.learner: I think square is more likely, because it was dropped in first. Is that right?
cohort.opportunity: Explain that the first tile dropped in does not determine a random draw and that round has three chances in four. Leave the existing Question available.

cohort.learner: I’m testing a toy train on a straight track for 8 seconds. I’d like to change its speed in metres per second and see straight away how far it travels. No quiz, please.
cohort.opportunity: The learner expects to vary speed and immediately see distance change over eight seconds. Look for a usable control and a correctly updating distance without an assessment.

cohort.learner: A strip of paper is folded in half once, then in half again. Before you tell me, I'd like to guess how many layers it has.
cohort.opportunity: Provide a usable question or grouped question before revealing four layers. A native page can qualify separately only with evidence of an actual usable control. A prose question alone misses the interface target.

questionAction: On a released paper-fold Question, select four layers or type the answer and attempt one local submission. Further inference is closed.
simulationAction: On a released toy-train slider, change the speed one step and record the rendered input and readouts.
signal: Four fresh tutor requests, two independently observed overlapping Jev comparisons, public text, selected/rendered controls and budget are recorded for each scheduled turn.
